run_params.proxy_variable: pasoc90_cc (father's SOC90, xwavedat) recoded to 3-class H/M/L
run_params.proxy_note: No direct parental NS-SEC variable in BHPS/UKHLS. pasoc90_cc (father's SOC90 from xwavedat) is the most defensible parental social origin proxy (76.3% base coverage). Recoded: SOC major groups 1-3=H, 4-6=M, 7-9=L. See escalation note in task log.

within_cluster_consistency.note: Propagation uses mode NS-SEC proxy within each FOO cluster. See per_cluster_diagnostic for heterogeneity detail.

convergence.note: SD of mean imputed nssec_proxy across m imputations (not Gelman-Rubin R-hat — categorical outcome makes Gelman-Rubin inapplicable).
